claims: Artemis 1 splashed down in the Pacific Ocean, west of Baja California near Guadalupe Island, on December 11, 2022.
The Orion capsule landed at 9:40 a.m. PST (12:40 p.m. EST).
The Orion capsule's landing concluded a 25.5-day mission.
The Orion capsule was recovered by the U.S. Navy and the USS Portland.
The Orion capsule safely completed a high-speed reentry to test the heat shield.
